name: registry-static
description: Publish remotes to a static registry (a folder, S3, R2 or MinIO) with mfeflow deploy, promote, rollback and status. Adds registry:deploy, registry:rollback and registry:status scripts, a guide, and, when ci-github is present, a workflow that deploys every remote when main changes. Credentials come from CI secrets and the environment only.

prompts.name: host
prompts.message: Registry host (file:<dir> or s3://<bucket>[/prefix]), empty to set it later

prompts.name: baseUrl
prompts.message: URL the host's files are served from (https://cdn.example.com), empty to set it later
